result.assumption: Safety-bounded evolution is necessary to ensure agents remain aligned with human values and avoid harmful behaviors.
result.inversion: Safety-bounded evolution is unnecessary and hinders the development of more capable and adaptive agents.
predictions: Agents evolved without safety constraints will exhibit higher rates of unintended harmful behaviors in controlled environments.
Agents with strict safety bounds will achieve significantly lower task performance metrics compared to unconstrained agents.
Agents evolved without safety constraints will show greater adaptability to novel environments and tasks, as measured by transfer learning performance.
